campuses.title: Dubai Internet City Campus
campuses.text: Главный и единственный кампус DMU Dubai — Building 12 в Dubai Internet City. Все факультеты (Business, Computing, Engineering, Media, Art and Design, Law) под одной крышей; рядом метро Internet City и tech-кластер города.

paragraphs: De Montfort University Dubai is the UAE branch campus of De Montfort University (DMU) Leicester, opened in 2021 in partnership with Dubai's Knowledge and Human Development Authority. Located in Building 12, Dubai Internet City, the campus delivers a curriculum mirrored from DMU Leicester and awards UK degrees recognised internationally.

DMU is the only UK university designated as the UN's Global Hub for Sustainable Development Goal 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities), and DMU Dubai embeds this ethos through community projects and industry partnerships across the Emirates. The Dubai cohort is fully international, with students from the GCC, South Asia, Africa, the CIS and Europe.

The Dubai campus offers programmes across the Faculty of Business and Law (Leicester Castle Business School, Leicester De Montfort Law School), the Faculty of Computing, Engineering and Media, and the DMU International College for foundation and pre-master pathways. Strong industry links in Dubai's tech and finance sectors give graduates direct access to internships and placement opportunities.

Students benefit from small class sizes, UK-trained faculty, modern teaching labs in Dubai Internet City, and the option to transfer to DMU Leicester for a UK study experience. Career outcomes are strong, with graduates placed at multinational employers and the Dubai government's free-zone employers.
paragraphsRu: De Montfort University Dubai — кампус De Montfort University (DMU) Leicester в ОАЭ, открыт в 2021 году в партнёрстве с Knowledge and Human Development Authority Dubai. Расположен в Building 12, Dubai Internet City. Программа полностью зеркалит DMU Leicester, диплом — британский, признан международно.

DMU — единственный UK-университет, назначенный UN Global Hub по Sustainable Development Goal 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities). DMU Dubai встраивает эту повестку в community-проекты и industry-партнёрства по всем Эмиратам. Cohort полностью международный — студенты из GCC, Южной Азии, Африки, СНГ и Европы.

Кампус Dubai предлагает программы Faculty of Business and Law (Leicester Castle Business School, Leicester De Montfort Law School), Faculty of Computing, Engineering and Media, а также DMU International College для foundation и pre-master pathway. Прочные индустриальные связи в tech- и finance-секторах Дубая дают студентам прямой доступ к стажировкам и placement.

Студенты получают небольшие группы, UK-faculty, современные labs в Dubai Internet City и опцию transfer в DMU Leicester для UK-семестра. Карьерные результаты сильные — выпускники работают в multinational-компаниях и free-zone employers Dubai government.
